scope: Existing six-request outputs only; LOCAL_SHAPE vs LOCKED_RAW, BASE and FINAL. No rescoring, intersection detection, model, geometry mutation, or experiment.

interpretation.connection: No same-stage legal CF/FF edge is lost by fitting. BASE has no new legal edge. FINAL has one new FF edge at 459/n0, length 0.06700172005811854 model units, source-edge [[140,0,2],[183,0,2]]. Both 459 requests still have zero legal CF edges and zero C-reached free faces; the extra FF edge is not a new C interface.
interpretation.conflict: 459/n1 replaces one retained-face FF illegal pair with three new ones at both stages, net +2 pairs. All other pair identities are unchanged by fitting. No disappearance is attributed to face removal.
interpretation.count_denominator: CF/FF affected fractions use output free-face counts, unchanged between arms (65,69,57,64,79,82 in request order a8n0,a8n1,27n0,27n1,459n0,459n1). 459/n1 FF affected counts increase 38->40 in BASE and 25->27 in FINAL. The +2.439024 percentage-point request increase is not an area-denominator artifact.
interpretation.area_denominator: Original RAW-area retention is identical between arms and stages, but fitted triangle area is smaller in all six requests. Reached-area fractions therefore cannot establish expanded connectivity: 27 has unchanged reached area/faces and legal edge identity; its larger fraction is entirely a smaller actual free-area denominator. a8 reached numerator and denominator both shrink; its ratio falls. 459 remains zero.
interpretation.deletion: 416 original free slots survive out of 1142 across six requests; 726 are absent. These are inherited assembly/source omissions, not fit-induced or new FINAL deletion. Selected union has 260/265 slots; the five already absent slots are common to both arms. No bridges are present.
interpretation.external_lock: The external domain is D0 BASE surviving unselected original free slots only: 156 per arm. All are retained with exact canonical coordinates at BASE. At FINAL all survive, but 16 per arm move relative to own/D0 BASE; maximum 0.09717587004636129 model units. Relative to original same-stage D0 FINAL only two slots differ (a8n0 slot113 and a8n1 slot123), maximum 0.04261358415869808. BASE hard lock does not imply FINAL hard lock.
interpretation.averaging: Counts and area sums are literal sums over six requests, never unique-parent counts. Parent macro means average two noises within each of the three parents, then parents equally; in this balanced panel it equals the request mean. Pooled RAW-area ratio is separately labeled.
interpretation.identity_limits: Legal edge keys use existing original RAW slot/corner identities; bridge correspondence excluded but none occurs here. This audit performs arithmetic on frozen ledgers and CSVs, without a new legal-edge detector or metric call.
